commit_message: Add ADR0127 Project Rust and Native 2D Editor workspace
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR0127 Native 2D first release
pr_body: Continues the current-main v6 ADR0127 first-release branch after the protocol-compliant foundation request. Adds the existing ABI v3 Project Rust SpriteAnimator2D command/state integration and the service-backed Native 2D Editor workspace with stable SpriteRef scene creation, typed Atlas/Animation/Tile Set authoring, and gesture-backed sparse Tile Map editing. Scene View projection/drop and proving-template work remain separate exact-head slices.
